info.description: This course equips students with foundational and practical knowledge of international trade, viewed through the lens of supply chain and logistics management. It explores the roles of key stakeholders in global trade, the interplay between international trade and freight forwarding, and the structure of trade contracts. Students will examine critical elements such as Incoterms 2020, delivery and payment terms, and common risks in cross-border transactions. The course also covers international trade regulations, major institutions governing global commerce, and financial and legal frameworks, including trade financing and dispute resolution mechanisms. Through hands-on case studies and the use of standard documentation, students will develop essential skills to effectively navigate global trade environments and contribute to trade operations in logistics and supply chain organizations.

clos.loDetails: Identify the roles, responsibilities, and legal status of international freight forwarders, and describe their interaction with trade activities.
Recognize the key elements of trade contracts, Incoterms 2020, delivery/payment terms, and the required transport documents in global trade.
Analyze the role of contracts in supply chain management, identify their core components, and outline the contract management process to support global trade operations.
Apply financial principles, risk management techniques, and trade financing methods in the context of freight forwarding.
Evaluate the structure, roles, and effectiveness of contract management, and explain how team performance influences contract outcomes.
Assess criteria and apply selection considerations for key partners and service providers within the international supply chain to support global trade activities.
Measure and evaluate contract performance using cost, time, and quality indicators, and recommend corrective actions where necessary.
Show professionalism, ethical behavior, and social responsibility while collaborating effectively on group projects.
